name: @pipeworx/mcp-blockchair

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Fetch chain-wide blockchain statistics (block count, transaction volume, hash rate, mempool size, circulation, etc.) for a given chain (bitcoin, ethereum, dogecoin, and 12 others).

tools.name: block
tools.description: Block details by hash or height.

hash_or_height.description: Block hash (hex) or numeric height as string.

tools.name: node
tools.description: Node software stats (sync status, version, latest block, …).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-blockchair forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the blockchair pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
